mapper.sql: id, user_id, job_posting_version_id, resume_version_id, profile_snapshot_json, rule_version, total_score, skill_score, experience_score, project_score, matched_json, gaps_json, confirmation_status, confirmed_at, created_at

m.id AS match_id, m.job_posting_version_id, pv.version_number AS jd_version_number, m.resume_version_id, rv.version_number AS resume_version_number, rv.status AS resume_status, m.rule_version, m.total_score, m.skill_score, m.experience_score, m.project_score, m.matched_json, m.gaps_json, m.profile_snapshot_json, m.confirmation_status, m.confirmed_at, m.created_at
FROM job_match_result m JOIN job_posting_version pv ON pv.id = m.job_posting_version_id LEFT JOIN resume_version rv ON rv.id = m.resume_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_match_result m JOIN job_posting_version pv ON pv.id = m.job_posting_version_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND pv.job_posting_id = #{postingId}
